correctness.rationale: Frame coefficients fiber by modulation Parseval and a four-class polyphase transform at αβ=4/5. Evenness gives a 3×3 parity block and 1×2 odd block; zero even determinant implies full 4×5 rank at most three. Periodic Cauchy sums yield a continuous closed expression for each entry. The independently replayed exact-rational interval checker rigorously proves the stated two opposite endpoint signs with ample margin; IVT supplies β*, and continuity of the fibers excludes a positive lower frame bound. The checker cannot prove the fiber theorem by numerical sampling and is not used for that purpose.

value.rationale: The first natural unresolved index p=4 of Ghosh’s explicit p/(p+1) conjecture obtains a rigorous existence theorem. This is a motivated finite cutoff, not an arbitrary parameter recomputation: p=1,2,3 were proven in the motivating article and p≥4 had only numerical evidence. A concrete exact-arithmetic witness transfers a conjectural non-frame obstruction into a theorem for the same fixed even rational generator. It does not resolve all p or describe an open set of lattices.
